transcript:
Header:
Date: 2027-02-10
Time: 09:00 AM PT
Duration: 62 minutes
Location: All-hands (Zoom)
Attendees: Maya (CEO), Liam (CTO), Zara (VP Product), Noah (Head Eng), Ava (Sales), Priya (People), plus ~120 employees

Summary:
Maya opened with a brief company update: good momentum, cautious spend, focus on Dedicated stability and Private enterprise readiness. Finance snapshot showed revenue growth, runway extended slightly due to cost discipline. Product highlighted Dedicated autoscale and private deploy installer progress, with compliance (SOC2) near completion. Q&A touched on latency/cost, roadmap timing, and hiring.

Topics covered:
- Q4 financials and runway
- Product roadmap: Dedicated, Private, Optimize features
- Security/compliance: SOC2, audit logs, KMS integrations
- Hiring: eng, security, sales
- Customer highlights and benchmarks

Transcript:
[00:00] Speaker 1 (Maya): hey everyone, good morning good morning, um thanks for joining the february all-hands. we'll get started, we've got a jam packed agenda today so i'll kick off with a quick company update then hand off to liam and zara for product and eng updates.
[00:22] Speaker 2 (Liam): thanks maya. quick heads up on infra — we've rolled out the kernel selector change on staging, seeing 10-15% lower p50 on our 8k context workloads, this is promising but still early.
[00:40] Speaker 3 (Zara): yeah i'll go into the roadmap in a minute, but the kernel selector plus smarter kv-cache eviction really helped throughput in the benchmarks we ran last week. there were a few flakey cases with on-prem GPUs — still debugging driver mismatches.
[01:05] Speaker 1 (Maya): finance quick take — q4 was better than our internal plan, ARR up 18% q/q, churn slightly under target. runway is now 18 months at current spend, we are being conservative on new hires but prioritizing security and core infra.
[01:28] Participant (unlabeled): sorry, do we have the exact churn number?
[01:32] Speaker 1 (Maya): yeah gross churn 3.2% monthly equivalent, net revenue retention around 112% — numbers will be posted in the allhands deck after the call.
[01:48] Speaker 2 (Liam): on the dedicated side, teams are focusing on predictability — autoscale policies that honor latency SLOs and dedicated pool fairness. preliminary tests show we can maintain p95 under 300ms for typical chat workloads on our nvidia-... um, on our GPU pool, with batching and prefix cache. rough numbers.
[02:20] Speaker 3 (Zara): product roadmap highlights: next 90 days — 1) Dedicated autoscale GA for early customers, 2) Private deployment installer (air-gapped option) beta, 3) Optimize recommendations UI for batching/quantization.
[02:45] Speaker 4 (Noah): engineering note — private installer had a packaging issue with one distro; we now have a workaround and expect the installer image to be stable by mid feb. that will unlock a couple of larger pilots.
[03:06] Speaker 1 (Maya): security — priya? sorry priya, priya... priya is people; uh i mean zara, or rather, liam, can you talk SOC2?
[03:18] Speaker 2 (Liam): sure, SOC2: stage 2 audit is scheduled for march, most remediation items are complete, we've got KMS integrations in place for key management, and audit logs are being routed to the central SIEM. there are a handful of outstanding policies to finalize.
[03:40] Speaker 5 (Priya): on the people front, hiring is prioritized for security engineers, infra SREs, and a small increase in account executives to support enterprise pipeline. please submit hiring requests by the 20th so we can triage.
[04:00] Speaker 6 (Ava): customer highlights — closed two mid-market deals in eu with dedicated commitments, and we renewed a key enterprise (FinPay) on dedicated with enhanced SLAs. great work to the account teams.
[04:20] Participant (Employee): can we get more detail on the finpay renewal?
[04:25] Speaker 6 (Ava): short version — they moved from hosted to dedicated for data isolation, we added audit log integrations and a 99.9% uptime SLA; price increase around 22% vs prior contract. i'll share the sanitized win doc in #customer-wins.
[04:48] Speaker 3 (Zara): quick note on benchmarks — we published internal comparisons vs Anthropic and OpenAI for typical generation tasks; results vary by model and prompt; our main win is cost-per-token on quantized variants and predictable p95 latency at scale. we'll open a public blog post later this quarter with sanitized graphs.
[05:20] Speaker 1 (Maya): ok q&a time — type your questions in the q&a panel. first question: what's the plan for private deployments in regulated finance customers?
[05:35] Speaker 2 (Liam): timeline: private beta mid-feb, GA late q2 contingent on installer stability and a successful cash pilot. for regulated customers we recommend private dedicated with customer-managed KMS and audit logs forwarded.
[06:05] Speaker 7 (Employee): any updates on pricing for on-prem/private?
[06:09] Speaker 6 (Ava): pricing is being updated — enterprise pricing with private deployment add-on, we'll circulate an FAQ and example TCO spreadsheet by next week.
[06:24] Speaker 2 (Liam): someone asked about fallback and graceful degradation — we continue to support auto-fallback to hosted variants when dedicated capacity is constrained, with rate-limited bursting. that logic is in the routing layer and will be more configurable in the console soon.
[06:50] Speaker 8 (Employee): could you clarify KV cache behavior across restarts?
[06:55] Speaker 3 (Zara): yes, prefix cache is persisted for warm starts in dedicated pools; on node restart there's a brief cold period while KV warms, we've got heuristics to pre-warm for high-traffic tenants. imperfect transcription: 'warm starts' sometimes shows as 'worm stars' in notes.
[07:20] Speaker 1 (Maya): next topic — org updates. priya?
[07:25] Speaker 5 (Priya): hiring plan posted, folks should align with managers on priorities. leadership is also updating career ladders for engineers and product — details in the doc posted after this meeting. a quick ask: managers please review headcount needs by the 20th.
[07:48] Speaker 9 (Employee): will there be any changes to compensation bands?
[07:52] Speaker 5 (Priya): no broad changes this quarter; we'll continue market salary adjustments in targeted buckets.
[08:05] Speaker 1 (Maya): ok last section — culture and rituals: thank you to the revenue ops and folks who shipped billing improvements. small shoutouts.
[08:22] Speaker 10 (Employee): shoutout to infra for the incident last week and quick mitigation, really appreciated.
[08:30] Speaker 4 (Noah): thanks — quick postmortem will be posted; root cause tied to autoscaler mismatch on a canary node. fix deployed.
[09:00] Speaker 1 (Maya): open q&a again — a couple of questions about model catalog and open models; customers want clarity on which variants are recommended for different workloads.
[09:18] Speaker 3 (Zara): roadmap includes a 'catalog guidance' feature in console: recommended model variants, quantization profiles, and expected throughput/cost for example workloads. will launch in alpha to internal teams first.
[09:42] Speaker 6 (Ava): sales note: highlight recommended variants in reps' playbook when proposing dedicated or hosted options; helps frame TCO conversations.
[10:05] Speaker 11 (Employee): question on SOC2: any risk to timeline if auditors ask for more evidence?
[10:12] Speaker 2 (Liam): there's always risk; we built a buffer into the plan, but teams should prioritize answers to auditor queries. security lead will coordinate.
[10:30] Speaker 1 (Maya): ok we're approaching the final 10 minutes. recapping concrete asks, then we'll close.
[10:38] Speaker 1 (Maya): recap: leadership to share full Q1 OKRs; engineering to publish targeted roadmap and installer timeline; sales to send enterprise FAQ and pricing; people ops to open hiring form. check slack for links.
[10:55] Speaker 6 (Ava): i'll post the finpay win doc and the TCO spreadsheet in #customer-wins and #sales respectively.
[11:05] Speaker 3 (Zara): internal alpha of the Optimize UI will be available next week to product and solutions folks for feedback — ping me if you want access.
[11:20] Speaker 5 (Priya): reminder to managers: submit hiring requests by 2027-02-20.
[11:30] Speaker 1 (Maya): thanks everyone. small note: town hall next month will focus on product demos and customer panels. meeting adjourned.

End of transcript.

Notes on transcription quality: automated captions had a few mis-hearings (e.g., 'KV' as 'K V' or 'worm stars' vs 'warm starts'), speaker attribution occasionally generic; cleaned up minimally for readability.
